Now your agent can integrate, debug, or customize your WorkOS implementation. Give the agent a screenshot or mock-up of your desired login page styling and it will set it up in WorkOS for you. Setup is simple, and it works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or any client that supports remote MCP. Team admins have full control over how their team uses it. They can turn MCP access on or off, and independently control whether it can access production environments or modify configuration. Learn more in the docs .
